notes.title: Progress report #2 - Anh and FC route ending...
notes.content:
... and a bit about Monkey.

Hey guys.

There are now:[list]
[*] 492 images
[*] 6 animations
[*] 1 gallery image
[/list]
This has been a very productive week.

I ended up re-writing one of the scenes almost completely (last 2 preview images). It's the scene about MC's father dying. I got tired of doing renders in uncle's office and since there is a scene with FC right after I figured I'd just have the two of them have a quick chat about the death of that dude, on their way home. It is a nice, sunny day after all.

Now, I am getting very close to the ending. Yeah, this update is going to be pretty short. As will the last route. There aren't a whole lot of unresolved things on both of these routes at this point in their stories.

Here are some previews:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/282ad56d21300da0d2b7b0a0e4a4549fefebf4a7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/207c958380de03abf7b9e02879c992ed10bb52fb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/91ba0973429157bae2068a7ac2638e0216d458ce.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/4891897a7b925af2b96f4bec7621058303cbc97e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/572ce1ba72b14c999a4c948ed533a2c66188ae1b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/115f7515d6f13fb17823664c59874fc8405f6151.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/ce1891d311a239f5975cf5115903d626b9a5240e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/181618cf14b49847e46f2a8e42825d9cc7674228.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/0b11514182aae6fd10e8244718e98313197a11e4.png[/img]

[h2]Ongoing issues:[/h2]
There is an issue for some of the Mac users starting a game through Steam.
I honestly have no idea how to fix that issue.
From what I have been able to find is that this has been an issue for about 3 years now. There isn't no "concrete" fix that anyone has been able to find. But there is one solution that seems to have worked for many people, (quoting the original post from reddit):

[i]When you start the game, press and hold the shift key (it should bring up a menu). Disable the gamepad and powersave (have been to know to cause problems), then try the three different renderer's listed there. That's all i got for Mac's.[/i]

And that is all I have found, other than starting the game from within the game's folder.


[h2]Now a bit about Monkey.[/h2]

I had to renrender Jessa's scene once again (after redoing it with the new hair.) I gave her a new skin. The old one looked great, but only her face. The rest of her looked as though she is made of plastic. I took a closer look at her and realized that, aside from her face, her skin has no details at all.  When I was making those "hair shots" I thought it was just the lighting that was kind of hiding details, but nope. The skin just has no details. So I gave her a new one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/301d054c654aceb157c3c2cfdf1c3957a707762d.jpg[/img]

I have also modified the dialogue between Jenny and MC, and made it less (I hope) of a "We'll bang, okay? Right this moment." And added a bit of a dialogue between MC and Anna for the scene where he offers to give her a loan for the tuition.  

I also have a bit of a bonus for you. Bunny day (Easter) is coming up so... 
(characters from the Monkey")

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/089901173eb84d194b45586751693f326340de4f.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/f575afc77ca97fc2fb125b285951532d6a03faeb.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/0d07764572e49c8bef5cc825f04150da587501c8.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822386/bc5f0a8087a491eb39f3812f6fd12d7028cd8fe2.jpg[/img]

That's all I got this week.
Have an awesome weekend.
Sit tight, smile wide.
volle.

notes.title: Progress update #5
notes.content:
Hey guys.
I am a couple of days late with the update. Apologies. I'll explain in a bit.

I am done with all the images, animations and the script for this update.
This update will contain
[list]
[*] 794 images,
[*] 4 gallery images,
[*] 32 animations
[/list]
Yup. The update is almost finished. We are just doing the translation and then it will onto coding, then testing.
And that is why I am a bit late with this progress update. I was hoping that I could figure out at least an approximate release date. But. at this point, I am still unsure. Won't be long though.

This update is the ending for Anh's solo route. And adds content only to this route.
Now, the not so pleasant news about this update. You will have to restart the game. Due to some technical issues the saves prior to this update will not work. I am not a programmer so I am not sure what exactly is the cause for this. I do know that Ren'py has released a new version of their software where some changes were made and those changes cause some issues. For example, the effects that One Lie has in the main menu no longer work and have to be redone. So, I am guessing that there are other changes that had a negative impact on the code of our game, resulting in older saves not working.

I have already started work on the next update. Which will be for the Harem route. This update will have to be the largest. I mean, IT IS the harem route after all. There isn't a whole lot I can say about it right now. Mostly, I am writing the script right now. But I have done some test renders as I am setting up the scenes for it. And that's all I got to say about the next update.

I also have news regarding the next game I am working on "Monkey."
We have built a demo for it. The demo is very very basic. It contains an almost complete Prologue of the game. I removed a few scenes from it that I do not think are very important to giving you an idea as to what the game is about and all of that. The demo also contains no music, sounds or custom main menu. 
I already released the demo to our Patrons, for testing. And I will release it publicly on October 16th. I will announce when that happens and have some screenshots of it here and in our Discord server.

That's all I've got for you this time.
Thank you very much for supporting and playing our game.
